data.title: Fmr. Iranian leader Ali Khamenei's week-long funeral begins second day in Tehran | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: The funeral began on Saturday in Tehran with chants of "death to America, death to Israel," and his body is expected to be taken to Qom, Najaf and Kerbala, the great Shi'ite centers of Iran and Iraq.
